scientific_integrity: Analytical proof establishes all cases, equality boundaries, and uniqueness. Script verifies representative finite cases, not an infinite-domain certificate. Full historical novelty and independent validation are not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Positive conductances and positive linear prices on an exact star with at least two leaves; no result for general trees, nonlinear prices, or other network objectives. A shorter 2006 conference source predates the first day-verified public electronic full text, but its precise first public day was not established; historical equivalent specialized results remain possible.
title: A majority-price transition for minimum resistance diameter on weighted stars
